meta._yoast_wpseo_title: HubSpot Integration: AI Calls for New Contacts | Botphonic
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: The Botphonic HubSpot integration has an AI voice agent call new contacts, then writes the lead status, lifecycle stage and a call note back to HubSpot.
meta._yoast_wpseo_opengraph-title: Botphonic + HubSpot: Call New Contacts Automatically
meta._yoast_wpseo_opengraph-description: Connect HubSpot in a few clicks. Botphonic's AI voice agent calls new contacts and writes the lead status, lifecycle stage and a call note back to HubSpot.
meta._yoast_wpseo_twitter-title: HubSpot Integration: AI Calls With Automatic CRM Updates
meta._yoast_wpseo_twitter-description: Botphonic calls new HubSpot contacts, or contacts that reach a lifecycle stage you pick, then updates the record for you. No code needed.

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Salesforce Integration for AI Voice Agents | Botphonic
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: The Botphonic Salesforce integration looks up each caller's record before the agent answers, updates fields mid-call and logs the call as a task.
meta._yoast_wpseo_opengraph-title: Botphonic + Salesforce: AI Calls That Know the Record
meta._yoast_wpseo_opengraph-description: Botphonic's AI voice agent can look up the Salesforce lead or contact before it answers, update records mid-call and log the outcome as a task.
meta._yoast_wpseo_twitter-title: Salesforce Integration: AI Calls With Your CRM Data
meta._yoast_wpseo_twitter-description: Greet returning callers by name, update Salesforce records during the call and log calls as tasks, all through the Salesforce REST API.

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Zapier Integration: AI Phone Calls From Any Zap | Botphonic
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Turn form fills and ad leads into AI phone calls. The Botphonic Zapier integration runs on Webhooks by Zapier and passes call results to other apps.
meta._yoast_wpseo_opengraph-title: Botphonic + Zapier: Start AI Phone Calls From Any Zap
meta._yoast_wpseo_opengraph-description: Send leads from forms, ads, sheets and booking tools to Botphonic with Webhooks by Zapier. An AI voice agent calls them and results flow back to your apps.
meta._yoast_wpseo_twitter-title: Zapier Integration: Turn Any Trigger Into an AI Call
meta._yoast_wpseo_twitter-description: Add a lead in any Zapier app and Botphonic's AI voice agent calls them. Then send call results to Slack, Google Sheets or your CRM with a second Zap.

meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: The Botphonic Zoho integration recognises callers in Zoho CRM, creates or updates leads from the conversation and logs calls in the Calls module.

meta._yoast_wpseo_opengraph-description: Recognise callers from Zoho CRM, create or update leads from the conversation and log calls in the Calls module. Zoho workflow rules can start calls too.
meta._yoast_wpseo_twitter-title: Zoho Integration: AI Calls Logged in Zoho CRM
meta._yoast_wpseo_twitter-description: Botphonic's AI voice agent knows returning callers, upserts leads without duplicates and logs calls in Zoho CRM. A workflow rule can trigger the call.

meta._yoast_wpseo_opengraph-description: When someone fills in your form, Botphonic sends them a WhatsApp message and runs your follow-up workflow, so every lead hears from you fast.
meta._yoast_wpseo_twitter-title: WhatsApp Integration: Automated Messages for New Leads
meta._yoast_wpseo_twitter-description: Botphonic messages new leads on WhatsApp as soon as they submit your form, then follows up through your workflow.
